name: SmartLipo
title: SmartLipo Laser Liposuction in Tustin | OC Concierge Doctor
description: SmartLipo laser-assisted liposuction in Tustin with Tariq A. Khan, MD. Minimally invasive fat removal for the abdomen, arms, thighs, hips, back, and neck.
h1: Remove stubborn fat through a tiny incision.
lede: SmartLipo is minimally invasive, laser-assisted liposuction. A thin laser tube liquefies fat cells, which are then gently suctioned out through a small incision.
glance: Laser-assisted liposuction for larger areas of stubborn fat.

signs.heading: Common areas
signs.intro: SmartLipo is designed for areas of stubborn fat that remain despite diet and exercise.

basics.heading: How SmartLipo works
paras: A thin laser tube is placed under the skin through a small incision. The laser heats fat cells until they turn into an oily liquid, which is suctioned out.

Because the fat is liquefied first, SmartLipo can treat larger areas through a smaller opening than traditional liposuction. It is a body contouring procedure, not a substitute for weight loss, and works best alongside a healthy weight.

steps.heading: Your procedure
items: Dr. Khan evaluates the area and whether SmartLipo is the right choice.
Laser-assisted fat removal through a small incision.
Contours refine as swelling settles over the following weeks.
